findings.title: The whole dev-rows file cannot be evaluated by mfos.metrics: 2D_Case_4 has layout and die rows but no reference row
findings.detail: The rebuilt rows include 6 layout rows and 8 die rows for 2D_Case_4 from the gates and band-check path, but no kind=reference row for it. `mfos.metrics.compute('headroom_min_lo', rows, ...)` on the file's full `rows` raises `ValueError: reference 2D_Case_4: layout or die rows but no reference row`. meta.metrics (h_lo 0.3254, h_hi +inf) reproduce exactly only after filtering to housing70x40_gen2_0. The old smoke file had rows for gen2_0 only, so a consumer that runs the metric on the whole file would now fail. The DoD and `--plan` read only meta, so nothing in the claim breaks.
findings.evidence: Inline recompute: the full rows raise the ValueError above. With only gen2_0 rows: headroom_min_lo 0.3254151371496821 == meta; headroom_max_hi_ind inf == meta; null_twin_as_best_h_lo 0.0 == meta; recon comparator 0.3254 == meta.
findings.suggested_check: Either emit a reference row (admissible, not counted) for gates-only dev references or mark those rows so the metric skips them; add a DoD line that runs MX.headroom_per_reference on the whole file.

findings.title: The rebuild from the saved VM work cannot be reproduced from this commit
findings.detail: The spec says the rows were rebuilt by `--dev --replay-only` from the saved result files of the 2026-11-13 VM run. Those files (research/o003/e008_dev/full_work, 333 files) are not tracked; they exist only untracked in the main checkout. The tracked experiments/drafts/E008_dev_work is the old smoke work directory: its fingerprints 065e8a…, d82a63… and aade64… are the smoke dev_pair and twin fingerprints. So no reviewer can regenerate E008.dev_rows.json from the repository. The file records no hash of the work directory, so the rows cannot be tied to those files either. I could not replay them: copying the files from the main checkout was denied in this session. The dev rows are labelled 'not evidence', so this limits auditability, not any registered result.
findings.evidence: `git ls-files experiments/drafts/E008_dev_work`: 56 smoke files. `ls research/o003/e008_dev/full_work` in this worktree: no such directory. The main checkout has it untracked (9.0 MB). The rows' meta.replay_only shows solves_started 0 and band_pairs {gen2_0: 0, 2D_Case_4: 4}.
findings.suggested_check: Record a sha256 manifest of the saved work directory in the rows' meta or in research/o003/e008_dev, so the replay can be tied to the files.

findings.title: Inconsistent role labels and schema in die rows
findings.detail: For gen2_0, the reconstruction's layout row has role 'reconstruction' while its die rows have role 'reference'. The 2D_Case_4 die rows have no role, GCI_K, tj_node_* or energy_balance fields. The metric does not read these fields today (my recompute matches), but downstream readers that key on role will see two names for one subject.
findings.evidence: Rows 'reconstruction'/d0..d3 for gen2_0 have role 'reference'. The 2D_Case_4 die rows have only Tj_l0..l2, nodes and power_W.
findings.suggested_check: Use one role vocabulary for layout and die rows, or document the mapping in e008_row_contract.md.

findings.title: Selftest coverage of the twin = reconstruction crash checked by reading the code, not by mutation
findings.detail: twin_is_recon_failures plants W = reference on both references through the registered path. It requires distinct 'twin' and 'reconstruction' layout labels with the same fingerprint, at least one die row for each, a counted reference, and a candidate re-keyed to W's fingerprint that gets its own label and die rows. A fingerprint-keyed label map (the likely old bug) would leave the twin with 0 die rows or no label, and the `min(dies.values()) < 1` and label-set conditions would fire. I tried to confirm this by monkeypatching thermal_subjects in a scratch run; the sandbox denied that run, so this is static reasoning only.
findings.evidence: experiments/runners/e008_run.py lines 2636-2684 and 2853-2863; the selftest passed with 0 failures ('selftest T0324 (W = reconstruction on both references, candidate = W): 0 failures').
findings.suggested_check: Add a selftest mutant that swaps thermal_subjects for a fingerprint-keyed version and requires a failure.

The rows' numbers are internally consistent and their metrics recompute, but I did not show they equal a replay of the VM files.

The `git diff --quiet $(git merge-base HEAD main) -- src tests/acceptance …` DoD line could not be run: this review checkout has a single snapshot commit and no main branch. I am relying on the provenance code check for it.
I ran `burst_full.sh --dry-run` only as part of a combined command that the sandbox denied, so I did not observe its output; I did not re-run it on its own.

The dev rows are development geometry and not evidence. h_lo 0.3254 and h_hi +inf on gen2_0 must not be cited as E008 results. The metrics computed over the whole rows file need gen2_0 filtered out first (finding 1).
